findings.finding: Whole-flush working map pins superseded saved owners; nested scopes do not release them.
findings.smallest_repair: Release consumed working owners after durable success while preserving live aliases and recovery references.
findings.closure_evidence: Active-action owner bounds, failed-save rollback and restore/revert parity; measured complete-action peak.

findings.finding: Import uses a complete R table; parser portability forces materialization; Parquet header discovery reads a full table.
findings.smallest_repair: Separate metadata discovery and bounded ingestion from whole-table compatibility hydration.
findings.closure_evidence: Parser, type, ordering, missing/nonfinite and raw-input preservation plus measured import memory.

findings.finding: Import saves before sanitization, saves again, and retains the original result through FASTA/configuration.
findings.smallest_repair: Normalize and compute small metadata before the necessary durable handoff; release the consumed full result.
findings.closure_evidence: Exact sanitization/attributes/logs and fewer unnecessary full writes without extra scientific checkpoints.

findings.finding: Design initialization embeds a full assay in a metadata bundle and saves it again as cleaned data.
findings.smallest_repair: Reuse an immutable table reference with separately bounded design metadata and explicit export dependencies.
findings.closure_evidence: Reset/edit/save/revert/portable-restore parity and no resave for unchanged-holder installation.

findings.finding: Status/summary/design metadata consumers request full payloads instead of metadata; same-flush identity reuse mitigates duplicate decodes but not whole-table demand.
findings.smallest_repair: Use reference existence and bounded summaries for metadata-only consumers.
findings.closure_evidence: Zero full decodes during metadata/style/status invalidation with identical UI content.

findings.finding: Whole-checkpoint writes and integrity reads retain file-backed pages outside the native-export-only I/O repair.
findings.smallest_repair: Remove redundant I/O first; measure file-specific residency handling while preserving integrity and durability.
findings.closure_evidence: Combined peak, file/process attribution and elapsed/read-I/O tradeoff on unchanged workload.

findings.finding: FASTA duplicates reads/output representations and keeps a global alias, but the measured annotation is only 4.54 MiB.
findings.smallest_repair: Bound header inspection; consider source-validated parser reuse only when its cost warrants it.
findings.closure_evidence: FASTA variant/mapping parity and a separately measured FASTA benefit.

findings.finding: After-flush ownership snapshots miss the active interval that fails, leaving stale zero counters.
evidence: both last GUI receipts versus committed owner inventories
findings.smallest_repair: Add bounded scalar substage observations using the existing diagnostic path.
findings.closure_evidence: Intra-action success/failure observations with retained pre-stop owner counts and no large logging overhead.
